{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ebon''' was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that produced black [[Wood/Legends|wood]]. Legend had it that seven massive monoliths carved from polished ebon surrounded the [[Parade Grounds]] of the [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]], the elite soldiers of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. All traces of the monoliths had vanished by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> By the time of the Galactic Civil War, ebon was considered to be rare. [[Celia Durasha]] owned a knife that had a handle carved from ebon.<ref name="ACPOV">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>
